title: A discrete approach to the functional Zhang's projection inequality
summary: In this paper, we focus our attention on the following inequality, which holds for any integrable log-concave function with positive integral $f$, and gives an inclusion between the $n$-th Ball body of the covariogram function of $f$ and its polar projection body, providing a functional version of Zhang's projection inequality in the setting of log-concave functions: $$ n\int_0^\infty r^{n-1}\int_{\mathbb{R}^n}\min\{f(z),f(z-re_n)\}dzdr\leq n!\frac{\left(\int_{\mathbb{R}^n}f(x)dx\right)^{n+1}}{\left(\int_{e_n^\perp}P_{e_n^\perp}f(y)dy\right)^n}. $$ Here $(e_i)_{i=1}^n$ denotes the canonical…
